ADG_ID.description: Aggregate Dispatch Group. Group into which the DUID is aggregated for Conformance. Null if DUID not aggregated for Conformance

CONNECTIONPOINTID.description: Country wide - Unique id of a connection point

DISPATCHSUBTYPE.description: Additional information for DISPATCHTYPE. For DISPATCHTYPE = LOAD, subtype value is WDR for wholesale demand response units For DISPATCHTYPE = LOAD, subtype value is NULL for Scheduled Loads. For DISPATCHTYPE = GENERATOR type, subtype value is NULL.

DISPATCHTYPE.description: Identifies LOAD, GENERATOR or BIDIRECTIONAL. This will likely expand to more generic models as new technology types are integrated into the NEM

DISTRIBUTIONLOSSFACTOR.description: The distribution loss factor to the currently assigned connection point

IS_AGGREGATED.description: Whether the DUID is classified as an "Aggregated Unit" under the rules. This impacts the Minimum Ramp Rate calculation

LASTCHANGED.description: Last date and time record changed

LOAD_MAXIMUM_ENERGY_PRICE.description: BDU only. Capped Offer/Bid Energy Price adjusted for TLF, DLF and VoLL for energy imports

LOAD_MAX_RAMP_RATE_DOWN.description: BDU only. MW/Min. Registered Maximum Ramp Rate Down value accepted for Energy Offers or Bids for energy imports

LOAD_MAX_RAMP_RATE_UP.description: BDU only. MW/Min. Registered Maximum Ramp Rate Up value accepted for Energy Offers or Bids for energy imports

LOAD_MINIMUM_ENERGY_PRICE.description: BDU only. Floored Offer/Bid Energy Price adjusted for TLF, DLF and MPF for energy imports

LOAD_MIN_RAMP_RATE_DOWN.description: BDU only. MW/Min. Calculated Minimum Ramp Rate Down value accepted for Energy Offers or Bids with explanation for energy imports

LOAD_MIN_RAMP_RATE_UP.description: BDU only. MW/Min. Calculated Minimum Ramp Rate Up value accepted for Energy Offers or Bids with explanation for energy imports

MAXIMUM_ENERGY_PRICE.description: Capped Offer/Bid Energy Price adjusted for TLF, DLF and VoLL

MAX_RAMP_RATE_DOWN.description: Maximum ramp down rate for Unit (Mw/min) - from DUDetail table

MAX_RAMP_RATE_UP.description: Maximum ramp up rate for Unit (Mw/min) - from DUDetail table

MINIMUM_ENERGY_PRICE.description: Floored Offer/Bid Energy Price adjusted for TLF, DLF and MPF

MIN_RAMP_RATE_DOWN.description: MW/Min. Calculated Minimum Ramp Rate Down value accepted for Energy Offers or Bids with explanation

MIN_RAMP_RATE_UP.description: MW/Min. Calculated Minimum Ramp Rate Up value accepted for Energy Offers or Bids with explanation

PARTICIPANTID.description: Participant that owns unit during effective record period

REGIONID.description: Region identifier that unit is in

SECONDARY_TLF.description: Used in Bidding, Dispatch and Settlements, only populated where Dual TLFs apply. For Bidding and Dispatch, the TLF for the generation component of a BDU, when null the TRANSMISSIONLOSSFACTOR is used for both the load and generation components. For Settlements, the secondary TLF is applied to all energy (load and generation) when the Net Energy Flow of the ConnectionPointID in the interval is positive (net generation).

STARTTYPE.description: Unit start type. At this time restricted to Fast, Slow or Non Dispatched

TRANSMISSIONLOSSFACTOR.description: Used in Bidding, Dispatch and Settlements. For Bidding and Dispatch, where the DUID is a BDU with DISPATCHTYPE of BIDIRECTIONAL, the TLF for the load component of the BDU. For Settlements, where dual TLFs apply, the primary TLF is applied to all energy (load and generation) when the Net Energy Flow of the ConnectionPointID in the interval is negative (net load).
